In addition, the replay-window optimizer reused the configured 12-hour safe floor as both champion and challenger, making challenger_window < champion_window impossible and recreating a false insufficient-evidence blocker after promotion.
truth_boundary: Candidate is not LIVE_PROVEN until protected merge, versioned production migration application, cron/function/view readback and runtime health readback succeed.
prevention_rule: Aggregate control-plane health fails closed on GREEN_STALE, ESCALATED reconciliation or stale PLANNED work; only explicitly NOT_STARTED side-effect-free internal work can be auto-requeued; obligations never auto-fulfil without outcome evidence; production and preview health remain separate signals; an already-proven optimization at the 12-hour safe floor is a terminal idempotent no-op.

outcome.truth_boundary: Do not promote to LIVE_PROVEN before protected merge, versioned production migration, active cron readback and functional runtime readback.
